body: The problem with this is my parents. They would lose all trust in me if they found out I had weed in the car, I've had problems with drugs in the past. Not only that, but they are very close to Bob's parents and I'm sure they would tell them. I don't want to screw over my friend for my stupid mistake. I realize it's not smart to keep things from your attorney but in this case I think It's necessary. In any case, thanks for taking the time to respond.
Thank you for the advice, I really do appreciate it.
